# sonarqube_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_project" "api" {
  project = "example-api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project key.

### Optional

- `retrieve_badge_token` (Boolean) Read the badge token (default true). Set false to skip the call, e.g. without 'Browse' permission on the project.

### Read-Only

- `badge_token` (String) Badge token, or null when not retrieved.
- `id` (String) The project key.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `tags` (Set of String) Project tags.
- `visibility` (String) `public` or `private`.
